point_in_time_sources.note: Used the latest verified closing price before the 2026-07-24 evidence cutoff; no unverified intraday or post-cutoff close was substituted.
Confirms Q2 results were not available before the evidence cutoff.

known_limitations: Stock-based compensation was not isolated as a standalone Q1 cash figure; the value-capture conclusion relies on observed net diluted share-count reduction rather than gross repurchases alone.
Interest coverage is a simplified operating-income-to-debt-expense proxy and not the company's covenant definition.
The price-odds screen annualizes one quarter of free cash flow only as a rough rejection check; it is not a formal intrinsic-value model.
Q2 2026 results were unavailable at cutoff and are prohibited from this sealed snapshot.
notes: Government and insurance payment stability was not treated as automatic pricing power. Snapshot conclusion was REJECT_AT_CUTOFF because mispricing and price-odds gates failed despite strong buyback execution.
